description: Latest Associated Press (AP News) articles: headline, publisher, publish time and link, newest first, optionally matching search words, from the last 1-30 days. Found through Google News's public RSS index of apnews.com (the site blocks automated clients); links are Google News redirect links to the article. Headlines only, no article text. Related tools on this server, for a different need: search_bbc_news_articles when you need BBC News top stories from the public BBC RSS feed; search_drive_com_au_news when you need Latest Drive.com.au articles: headline, publisher, publish. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

days.description: Only articles from the last N days, 1 to 30 (default 7)

q.description: Words to search for within the site (optional, max 150 characters), e.g. election
